events.description: Rachel Green says everyone has run out of time for the current turn in the game.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller is referring to a bird with the movie title 'Bye Bye Birdie'.
Rachel Green says it is Rachel Green's turn to play now.
Chandler Bing says Rachel Green should start her turn now.
